legend: Relationship of RNA sequencing gene expression signatures of B-ALL/LBL with ETV6::RUNX1 and B-ALL/LBL with ETV6::RUNX1-like features. Compared with other B-ALL subtypes, B-ALL/LBL with ETV6::RUNX1 rearrangement (yellow, n = 84) shares a unique distribution with B-ALL/LBL with ETV6::RUNX1-like features (red, n = 9) by t-distributed stochastic neighbour embedding (t-SNE) plot (N = 519).
source: Lu Wang MD PhD FACMG, Medical Director, Molecular Pathology & Maria Cardenas PhD, David Wheeler PhD, and Alex Gout PhD, Bioinformatics, St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, Memphis, TN
